Container.Name: Wordly
Container.Overview: Self-hosted collection of 11 daily word and logic games with shared leaderboards and 100% offline phone PWA support: Wordly (5 or 6 letter word + Hard Mode), Spelly Bee, Boxy Letters, Connecty, Strandy (6x8 word trails + Spangram), Searchy (Easy/Med/Hard word search), Mini Crossy (5x5), Midi Crossy (8x8-11x11), Crossy (Monday/Tuesday NYT 15x15), Tiley (layered tile matching), and Sudoky (Easy/Medium/Hard 9x9 Sudoku). Includes a 30-day archive for missed days, practice mode, cross-device profile sync, emoji shares, and 20 themes (including OLED Black). Map /data to appdata so leaderboards survive updates.
Container.DonateText: Enjoying Wordly? Buy Jacob (original creator) a coffee

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Leaderboard scores are stored here. Keep this mapped so they survive container updates.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set to 1 if Wordly sits behind a reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel, so rate limits use each player's real IP. Leave empty if players connect directly.

Config.Name: RATE_LIMIT_WRITES
Config.Description: Score submissions allowed per IP per minute.

Config.Name: RATE_LIMIT_READS
Config.Description: Leaderboard reads allowed per IP per minute.
